description: Define one canonical extraction fidelity model that truthfully represents provenance, omission, structural loss, degradation suspicion, and low-confidence review posture.
verify: Verify representative clean and risky extraction cases produce canonical fidelity states without falsely reporting clean extraction
notes: Completed by introducing a canonical extraction fidelity model with provenance, structural-loss suspicion, omission, degradation, and low-confidence posture, then routing existing extraction consumers through that model without broadening user-facing output yet.

description: Surface canonical fidelity state through review summaries and machine-readable audit output so users see one consistent extraction trust story.
verify: Verify review and audit outputs match for representative clean and risky extraction cases
notes: Completed by surfacing canonical extraction fidelity through review summaries and audit JSON, including provenance and low-confidence/structural-loss signals while keeping the slice bounded away from broader triage UI work.

description: Make DOCX extraction explicitly report omitted non-text content and structural flattening so review trust matches what the extractor really preserved.
verify: Verify representative DOCX fixtures surface omission and flattening signals end-to-end
notes: Completed by teaching DOCX extraction to return fidelity evidence directly, including explicit non-text omissions and structural-loss suspicion for flattened constructs such as tables, then flowing that through the shared fidelity model.

description: Detect low-confidence and degraded PDF extraction separately from hard extraction failure, including token-fusion and page-furniture style hazards.
verify: Verify clean, degraded, and non-extractable PDF fixtures produce distinct observable outcomes
notes: Completed by separating hard PDF extraction failure from successful-but-risky extraction and making low-confidence review posture come from explicit hazard detection such as token fusion and repeated page furniture rather than mere normalization changes.

description: Introduce OCR-backed extraction provenance with redundancy and fallback so native extraction can be supplemented or replaced when untrustworthy.
verify: Verify at least one fallback or redundancy case changes observable provenance and review posture
notes: Completed as a bounded OCR fallback slice: PDFs without native extractable text can now fall back to local OCR tooling, provenance is marked as OCR-backed, and review/audit output explicitly warns when OCR participated.

description: Make degraded, OCR-involved, omitted-content, and low-confidence files triageable in directory summaries and the desktop results workflow.
verify: Run npm run build if frontend assets change
Verify representative DOCX, PDF, and OCR-involved files are surfaced correctly in summaries and desktop views
notes: Completed by surfacing provenance, structural-loss suspicion, low-confidence review posture, and OCR involvement in run-level summaries, desktop file rows, and preview notes so risky files are triageable without opening each one blindly.
